user_text: I am here on a school trip with my class. Can you show me a painting with many colors?

robot_messages.main: I think you will love "Water Lilies" by Claude Monet! Look at all those water flowers, because Monet painted this pond over and over since he loved how the light changed the colors every day. Can you see the pretty reflections in the water? It is full of bright blues, greens, and violets that mix together like a dream. You can find it right next to "Las Meninas."
robot_messages.follow_up: Did you like the colors in Water Lilies?
